user_query: Identify the enzyme and elucidate its catalytic activity, especially the chemical reaction it catalyzes. Use sequence properties, Pfam/domain evidence, homologs, curated functional annotations, EC/Rhea reactions, cofactors, and relevant GO/pathway annotations. Distinguish direct curated evidence from homology-based inference; do not infer exact substrate specificity solely from sequence similarity.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
